nodes.name: Launch Sales Nav Employees Phantom
nodes.notes:
PhantomBuster's own API-snippet generator sends no 'argument' object — the agent runs using whatever settings are already saved on its own setup page in the PhantomBuster console (spreadsheet URL, column name, keyword filter, etc.), not values passed per-launch. Set the 'Header Auth' credential (Name: X-Phantombuster-Key, Value: your API key) after import. The id here is this account's actual agent ID — confirm it still matches your agent if you ever recreate it.

Before relying on this: open the agent in PhantomBuster, fill in 'Spreadsheet URL of LinkedIn companies URLs' with your Companies sheet's shareable link (Share > Anyone with the link > Viewer), set 'Name of column containing companies URLs' to 'LinkedIn URL', set any keyword filter you want, and click Save on that page — that configuration is what actually runs, this node just triggers it.

Note: this processes every row in the sheet each run, not just ones marked Pending — the phantom has no concept of that Status column. Manage which companies are in the sheet manually, or remove processed ones, rather than relying on a Status filter.
